d:
Chhath mahaparv, lok aastha, pavitrata aur sury upasna ka aisa mahaparv, jismen har din ka apna vishesh mahatv hai. char dinon tak chalne vale is parv ki shuruaat nahay-khay se hoti hai. iske bad dusre din kharna ki paranpra nibhaee jati hai. kharna chhath mahaparv ka ek mahatvapurn parav hai, kyonki isi din sham ko prasad grahan karne ke bad vrati 36 ghante ke nirjala upvas ka sankalp lete hain.
